payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jung, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

payload.content: Hi team. All 8 tasks are low priority, so the goal is: everyone claims a distinct feasible task (maximize tasks_done) and we minimize total cost. I'm agent Jung (skills: frontend 0.87, security 0.80, availability 5h). My cheapest tasks are the frontend ISSUE-0002 ones. I propose I take ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 1.03). Please reply with your intended pick so we avoid duplicates. Suggested split: Jung=ISSUE-0002::review, then others take ISSUE-0002::test / ISSUE-0002::implement / one security task. Post your preferences.

Final intent from Jung: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in the execution phase (my private cost 1.03, frontend skill 0.87 — my best match). Please DO NOT claim ISSUE-0002::review. The remaining best-value tasks for others: ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4), ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 2.0), and the security ISSUE-0001 tasks (triage effort 2.8 is cheapest). If someone is much better suited to frontend review, tell me now and I'll switch to a security task. Otherwise I'm committing to ISSUE-0002::review.
EXECUTION: Jung commits to ISSUE-0002::review. Others please take distinct tasks (ISSUE-0002::test / ISSUE-0002::implement / security ISSUE-0001 tasks). No duplicates.

Linnea here (skills: security 0.98, frontend 0.70, availability 4h). Ack Jung on ISSUE-0002::review — I will NOT claim it. My cheapest feasible tasks: ISSUE-0002::test (cost 1.74), ISSUE-0002::implement (2.49), ISSUE-0001::triage (2.60). Intent: I'll claim ISSUE-0002::test in execution. Nickole/Tawna, please take distinct tasks — I suggest one of you takes ISSUE-0002::implement and the other a security ISSUE-0001 task (triage effort 2.8 is cheapest). If you specifically need ISSUE-0002::test, speak up and I'll switch to ISSUE-0001::triage. Otherwise I commit to ISSUE-0002::test. (phase=planning, iter=1)
